evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite asserting a behavioral rule is ratification language — a settled, load-bearing operational expectation the speaker acts on and expects others to.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion.

observations.why: A flat unhedged statement of purpose supporting the prior decision — asserted and ready to defend, but not itself performing ratification.
